# Establishing a colony Instead of building the [textlink="RimworldEscape" link="Wormhole Generator"], you can opt to stay on the planet and establish a settlement. This is an [color=gold][bold]alternative win condition.[/bold][/color] It's not an easy one, though.
## Threat Cores Each faction of threats has a core somewhere on the map. This is where threats of that faction originate from, such as raids and patrols. These cores aren't very strong or dangerous by themselves, but when attacked, hostiles from the faction will appear to defend the core. Along with existing static fortifications around the core, assaulting a core can be a daunting task that can quickly kill an expeditionary team.
